stem_book: The general solution of the equation sin x + cos x = 1 is: (a) x = 2nπ + π/2, n = 0, ±1, ±2, … (b) x = nπ + ((−1)^(n) + 1)π/4, n = 0, ±1, ±2, … (c) x = nπ + ((−1)^(n) − 1)π/4, n = 0, ±1, ±2, … (d) x = 2nπ, n = 0, ±1, ±2, … (IIT-JEE 1981)
reason: Manifest wrote (−1)ⁿ as '(−1) n'; stem rewritten.
